findings.title: R10_VALIDATION cites the port TX <= 3.6 V rule as 'binding note obligation 15'; counted from 1, entry 15 is the TPS2553 FAULT obligation

evidence.measured_value: r10_binding_note.json firmware_obligations has 36 entries. Counted from 1, entry 15 is 'Camera TPS2553 FAULT deglitch ...' and entry 16 holds the 3.6 V TX rule. The rule is index 15 only when counted from 0, and the note gives no numbers. No other document cites an obligation by number.

findings.impact: A reader who counts from 1 lands on the wrong obligation. The rule itself is stated correctly in the binding note, ORDERING 8, parts_qualification and M3_R10. This is an evidence-pointer defect only.
findings.concrete_fix: Replace 'binding note obligation 15' with 'binding note firmware_obligations entry starting "On VLOGIC undervoltage/shutdown" (R20-MCU-02)', or give the obligations stable IDs.

fix_verification.claim: U1 pad 74 has ZONE_CONNECTION_NONE; it keeps its own F.Cu stub and via (17.5,39.3); the via-less 0.282 mm^2 F.Cu GND piece is gone
fix_verification.measurement: Board 0dc84776: U1.74 GND, local zone connection 0 (NONE); F.Cu segment (17.5,35.45)-(17.5,39.3) w 0.2 mm to a GND via (17.5,39.3) d 0.3 / 0.5 mm, which sits inside the filled R10_GND_F, R10_GND_B and R10_GND_In1. On board 50a39de5 the same stub and via existed, plus an F.Cu GND island of 0.2822 mm^2, bbox (17.10,34.20)-(17.90,34.76), with no via, touching only pad 74. That island is gone on 0dc84776. Pin 75 decoupling C17 B(17,37.48) still returns to the same via (17.5,39.3). The only U1 pad difference between the two boards is pad 74's zone connection: nets, positions and the other 99 pads are identical.

fix_verification.claim: New PORT_4V8 FB-tap via (30.575,11.6) 0.25 mm from GPS_RX_MCU; GPS_RX_MCU run unchanged
fix_verification.measurement: In the track diff between 50a39de5 and 0dc84776, the only changed nets are AUX_RX_WIRE, AUX_TX_WIRE, GND, USB_LIMITED and PORT_4V8 (+2 items). GPS_RX_MCU and every other U1 net have byte-identical tracks. DRC 0 / 0 / 0.

fix_verification.claim: D440/D441 move to B.Cu under J440 on AUX_TX_WIRE / AUX_RX_WIRE; MCU side unchanged
fix_verification.measurement: D440.1 AUX_TX_WIRE B(4.45,19.125), D440.2 GND; D441.1 AUX_RX_WIRE B(4.45,22.725), D441.2 GND. AUX_TX_MCU (U1.63, R471.1) and AUX_RX_MCU (U1.64, R470.2) are unchanged in pads and tracks. All 666 pad nets are identical to 50a39de5.

fix_verification.claim: GPS USART3 PD8/PD9 AF7, radio UART5 PB13/PB12 AF14, AUX USART6 PC6/PC7 AF7
fix_verification.measurement: DS12110 Rev 8: PD8 AF7 USART3_TX and PD9 AF7 USART3_RX (Table 13, continued page p94); PC6 AF7 USART6_TX and PC7 AF7 USART6_RX (Table 12 p92); PB12 AF14 UART5_RX and PB13 AF14 UART5_TX (Table 11 p91). In Table 9, PD8 / PD9 / PC6 / PC7 are FT_h and PB12 / PB13 are FT_u. On the board, U1.55 GPS_TX_MCU-R441-GPS_TX_WIRE-J410.3, U1.56 GPS_RX_MCU-R440-J410.4, U1.52-R451-J420.3, U1.51-R450-J420.4, U1.63-R471-J440.3 and U1.64-R470-J440.4: TX goes to pin 3 and RX to pin 4 on all three ports.

fix_verification.claim: Port TX enabled only while PA4 (U11 ST) reads low
fix_verification.measurement: U11.9 ST is pulled up by R91 10 kOhm to 3V3 (inside TI's 6-20 kOhm RST band, SLVSEA3F p6) and goes to U1.28 PA4. IN2 = U11.2 RAW_PROTECTED and IN1 = U11.7 USB_LIMITED. SLVSEA3F Table 9-3 p18: 'ST is pulled high when the output is Hi-Z or IN1. It is pulled low when IN2 is powering the output.' The rule appears in the pin_table rows for PD8, PB13 and PC6 and in binding obligations 16 and 21.

fix_verification.claim: Never write VREFBUF_CSR; never clear HIZ
fix_verification.measurement: Binding obligation 36 and M3_R10 'Firmware' now forbid any write to VREFBUF_CSR. U1.20 VREF+ and U1.21 VDDA are both on 3V3A (with U4.5, U4.8 and U5, through R164). R164 is 2.2 Ohm: LCSC C22939 = UNI-ROYAL 0603WAF220KT5E, 2.2 Ohm 1 %. RM0433 could not be downloaded (timeout), so the mode table is still an Inference, as the record already states.

fix_verification.claim: TX <= 3.6 V rule, unmapped-port analog rule, parts_qualification pin map
fix_verification.measurement: Binding obligation 16 holds the 3.6 V rule and obligation 3 the unmapped-port rule. ORDERING line 595, M3_R10 line 796, R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF line 43 and parts_qualification lines 82-89 / 730 carry the current pin map (R441 / R440 to PD8 / PD9, R471 / R470 to PC6 / PC7, D440 / D441). One cross-reference defect remains: R21-MCU-01.

fix_verification.claim: Q122 gate: R122 1k series, R123 2k pull-down, C123 10 nF gate to GND
fix_verification.measurement: ACT_EN_MCU = U1.16 PC1 and R122.1; ACT_EN = R122.2, Q122.1, R123.1 and C123.1. Values are R122 1k C11702, R123 2k C4109 and C123 10 nF C15195. Thevenin is 2.2 V through 667 Ohm, tau about 6.7 us before Ciss. PC1 is FT_ha with RTC_TAMP3/WKUP5 (DS12110 Rev 8 Table 9 p66), matching obligation 7.

fix_verification.claim: R126 220R series, R127 1k pin pull-down, R128 10k + C126 220 nF gate-source
fix_verification.measurement: PYRO1_GATE_N = U1.3, R126.1 and R127.1 (R127.2 GND); PYRO1_GATE = R126.2, R128.1, C126.1, Q124.4 and TP122. Values are as recorded.

fix_verification.claim: U4 ISM6HG256X INT1 to PE1 EXTI1; push-pull active high; output forced to ground by default
fix_verification.measurement: IMU_INT1 = U1.98 PE1 and U4.4 only. ISM6HG256X datasheet pin table: pin 4 INT1, 'Default: output forced to ground'; PP_OD default 0. U4 is at B(17,45.9), rotation 180; x lever arm 17 - 23 = -6.0 mm, which matches the binding note.

fix_verification.claim: U1.19 VSSA no zone connection, own stub and via
fix_verification.measurement: U1.19 GND, zone connection 0; 0.3 mm stub to via (26.0,46.75), which sits inside the F, B, In1 and In2_Y1 GND fills.

fix_now_recommendations.change: docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 1996: replace 'binding note obligation 15' with a content reference (the 'On VLOGIC undervoltage/shutdown' obligation, R20-MCU-02). Text only.

rejected_or_closed_candidates.candidate: U1.74 lost its ground connection with the pour
rejected_or_closed_candidates.reason: It keeps its stub and via, which are in three GND fills. The removed island had no via, and DRC reports 0 unconnected.

rejected_or_closed_candidates.candidate: R164 MPN 0603WAF220KT5E might be 22 Ohm, not 2.2 Ohm
rejected_or_closed_candidates.reason: LCSC C22939 page: UNI-ROYAL 0603WAF220KT5E, 2.2 Ohm +/-1 %, 0603. Value, LCSC and MPN agree.

rejected_or_closed_candidates.candidate: pin_table RX/TX rows do not repeat the 3.6 V and unmapped-port rules
rejected_or_closed_candidates.reason: Both rules are in binding obligations 3 and 16 and in M3_R10 'Firmware'. The pin_table rows give the port map and the PA4 rule. Not a defect.
It is in the historical 'Confirmed by round 18' block. The current rule (3.6 V) is stated at line 1996 and in the binding note.

rejected_or_closed_candidates.candidate: USB VBUS sensing on PC8 instead of PA9
rejected_or_closed_candidates.reason: The usb_sense sheet note says 'Do NOT enable native PA9 VBUS sensing (VBDEN)', and binding obligation 29 covers the PC8 threshold.

No change since round 20. port_states.port_device_backfeed and the e-match / USB / self-powered-module restriction stand; it is procedural, as recorded. PA4 ST low implies IN2 = RAW_PROTECTED is valid, which feeds U400 and then U401, so the TX enable rule is consistent. If U400 or U401 is in fault, the module is unpowered anyway.

rejected_or_closed_candidates.candidate: PC1 is also ADC123_INN10 (negative input paired with PC0)
rejected_or_closed_candidates.reason: Only differential mode on channel 10 would involve PC1. Obligation 22 reads PC0 single-ended. Not a hazard.
